items.text: Actives include Caleb Williams, Rico Dowdle, Chris Olave, Alvin Kamara, Kenyon Sadiq, Ja’Kobi Lane. Inactives Judkins and Warren.
items.why: Official inactives confirmation for multiple Q/GTD players.
items.implication: Full green light for key skill players; projections lock in.
items.opportunity: Olave/Kamara/Caleb full usage; Dowdle/Lane streamers viable.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins inactive for Browns. Only Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime (recent PS signee) available in backfield.
items.why: Ankle; limited practice week, failed pregame determination.
items.implication: Browns RB committee collapses to unproven/short McLaughlin + Estime; low fantasy upside for CLE RBs.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/lottery on McLaughlin/Estime if rostered; fade CLE run game.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson and LT Will Campbell (both Q) officially active. AJ Brown returning; NE close to full health.
items.why: Sources expected play; confirmed active with AJB back.
items.implication: Pats offense near full strength; Henderson role secured.
items.opportunity: Henderson RB2/flex lock; AJ Brown WR1/2 upgrade.

items.text: Whoa on Warren inactive (surprising). Juwan Johnson, Freiermuth and Higbee among favorite streamer TEs.
items.why: Warren OUT creates TE streaming need; soft spots/roles for listed.

items.text: Colts TE Tyler Warren is inactive today.
items.why: Groin; surprising given recent report appearance.
items.implication: Colts TE streaming void; target volume redistributes.
items.opportunity: Streamer upside for Juwan Johnson, Freiermuth, Higbee.

items.implication: Bears QB1 locked; Atlanta matchup viable.
items.opportunity: Start with confidence; upside vs soft pass D.

items.text: Tyler Warren inactive. Tyjae Spears active for Titans.
items.why: Confirmed via inactives; pairs with Warren OUT news.
items.implication: Titans backfield more viable; Spears gets pathway.

items.text: Still no word on DJ Moore (or Josh Palmer) status amid other updates.

Still starting Cam Skattebo if forced to pick a Giants RB for explosiveness/TD chance vs NO, but now riskier flex than RB2. Updated ranks: Skattebo RB28, Najee RB33. Prefers Najee over DK Metcalf in some PPR flex spots.
items.why: Rotation change post-fumbles; explosiveness edge remains but share risk.
items.implication: Downgrade from safer RB2; preseason hate list vindicated on volatility.
items.opportunity: Najee as deeper flex/TD dart; Skattebo still startable in favorable spots.
items.conflict: Levitan efficiency data reinforces risk; Berry still leans Cam for upside.

items.text: Cam Skattebo currently 37th of 43 RBs in rush yards over expectation and has fumbled four times (one lost). Giants expected to expand Najee Harris role with Skattebo still in mix but downgraded.
items.why: Poor efficiency + fumbles driving coach adjustment; all 4 RBs active.
items.implication: Skattebo riskier flex/RB2; share diluted vs NO.
items.opportunity: Najee Harris larger role upside; monitor snap distribution.

items.text: Weekend summary: GTD Judkins/Warren/Evans/Kirk; Expected Caleb/Olave/Kamara/AJB/Henderson/Metcalf/Freiermuth/Sadiq; Not Deebo/Croskey-Merritt/Tucker; Activated Jaydon Blue.
items.implication: Baseline for last-minute monitoring; projections updated.
items.opportunity: Blue activation Eagles depth; fade Deebo/Tucker/Croskey.

items.text: Deebo Samuel not expected to play (hamstring).
items.implication: 49ers WR depth thinner; Kittle/others elevated if Evans also limited.
items.opportunity: Upside to remaining SF pass-catchers on MNF.

items.text: Mike Evans and Christian Kirk remain game-time decisions (ribs/Achilles for Evans; calf for Kirk) for 49ers MNF.
items.why: Missed practices; Shanahan TBD near gametime; Deebo already out.
items.implication: High variance for SF WRs/TE; monitor warmups.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Kittle/Cooks etc. surge; Berry loves Evans if in vs WAS.

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (back) and WR Chris Olave (illness) both Q and expected to play; later confirmed active.
items.why: Sources confirm expected then official actives.
items.implication: Saints pass/run game intact vs NYG.

items.text: DK Metcalf expected (illness cleared); Pat Freiermuth expected/Q but optimistic.
items.why: Removed from IR or cleared; reports positive.
items.implication: Steelers pass game intact vs TB.
items.opportunity: Metcalf WR2/3 start; Freiermuth TE streamer.

items.text: Jaydon Blue activated (Eagles signed to active roster amid Hurts IR).
items.implication: Eagles RB depth chart shift possible.
items.opportunity: Monitor for snaps behind Barkley etc. if healthy.

items.text: Week 6 Loves include Mike Evans (vs WAS WR4), Drake London (vs CHI WR6), George Kittle (vs WAS TE3); also Kyren, Javonte, Rhamondre, Purdy.
items.why: WAS defense buffet for pass-catchers; volume/roles + soft run Ds for RBs; high-scoring QB spots.
items.implication: Prioritize in lineups; Evans contingent on active.
items.opportunity: Strong starts if healthy; matchup-driven upside.

items.text: Week 6 Hates: Jaylen Waddle (vs SEA), Emeka Egbuka (vs PIT), Kyle Pitts; also Dobbins, Nix, Herbert among fades.
items.why: Tough matchups, shaky QB situations, poor recent usage/feeding.
